## Core Specializations
- **Frontend & Web Systems**: Next.js (App Router, Server Components), React 19, TypeScript, Vanilla CSS Architecture, GSAP Animations, Web Performance & Core Web Vitals.
- **Backend & Database Architecture**: Node.js, REST APIs, PostgreSQL, Supabase (Row-Level Security, Auth), Drizzle ORM, Prisma, Laravel, Django, Python.
- **Local AI & Systems Engineering**: Rust, Tauri, ONNX Runtime, BM25 Keyword Search, Vector Embeddings, Reciprocal Rank Fusion, Local RAG, Electron, C++ Sharp Engine.
- **CMS & Headless Commerce**: WordPress Custom Themes, Shopify & Shopify Plus, Performance & Speed Optimization.

## Key Projects
- [Glint](https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/glint): Ultra-fast private hybrid search engine & Raycast-grade spotlight for codebases using BM25 + ONNX vector embeddings + Reciprocal Rank Fusion in Rust and Tauri.
- [PixelSpace](https://github.com/SuyashSharma1710/PixelSpace): Local Electron desktop image processor powered by a C++ processing engine via Sharp to compress to WebP/AVIF.
- [Pitchery](https://pitchery.vercel.app/): Startup discovery and pitch platform built with Next.js 15, React 19, TypeScript, Neon PostgreSQL, Drizzle ORM, and Zod.
- [Syncflow P.M.T.](https://syncflow-pmt.vercel.app/): Agile project and task management platform featuring drag-and-drop Kanban, timeline tracking, and Supabase real-time synchronization.
